Star Squadron is LIVE on Kickstarter, and we're already past the halfway mark. 🚀

A tactical starfighter dogfighting game for 2 players, 45 minutes, with big detailed minis and four very different factions to fly. Every pilot plans a maneuver in secret, then everyone moves at once. Guess right, and you're on their tail. Guess wrong, and they're on yours.

Back it now: link in bio.

#StarSquadron #boardgames #kickstarter #miniatures #tabletopgames

What is Star Squadron? Two pilots. A hex field. Forty-five minutes.

Each round you secretly choose a maneuver card, then both sides reveal and move simultaneously. No waiting for your turn, no take-backs. The whole game lives in that moment of "where do I think they're going?"

Now funding on Kickstarter, link in bio.

#StarSquadron #boardgames #kickstarter #miniatures #tabletopgames

FACTION SPOTLIGHT: Eisenkiesel

Human pilots, hard-nosed engineering, and ships like the Velociraptor superiority fighter with lock-on missiles. If you like flying something with a lot of red paint and a lot of guns, start here.

Which faction would you fly? Tell us below. 👇

Star Squadron is on Kickstarter now, link in bio.

#StarSquadron #boardgames #kickstarter #miniatures #tabletopgames

The maneuver board is the heart of Star Squadron.

Every pilot picks a move, face-down, at the same time. Banks, slides, loops, splits, and each pilot's own special move. Then everyone flips and the ships move together. There's no hiding behind turn order, just reading your opponent.

Now on Kickstarter, link in bio.

#StarSquadron #boardgames #kickstarter #miniatures #tabletopgames

FACTION SPOTLIGHT: Vermarine

Living ships, plasma-green weapons, and pilots that aren't quite what you'd call human anymore. Vermarine craft bring a bio-organic edge to the battlefield and look like nothing else on the table.

Star Squadron is funding on Kickstarter now, link in bio.

#StarSquadron #boardgames #kickstarter #miniatures #tabletopgames

Weapons. Boost. Shields. You never have enough energy for all three.

Every round in Star Squadron you're deciding where the power goes: hit harder, move faster, or survive the shot you think is coming. Your pilot's ability can bend those rules, if you roll well.

Back the campaign, link in bio.

No renders here, these are the actual prototype minis on the actual table.

The starfighters in Star Squadron are big, detailed, and built to be the centerpiece of the hex field. Unpainted, they already look the part. Painted, they'll be something else.

Help us get them made: Kickstarter link in bio.

FACTION SPOTLIGHT: Citrine

Gold-armored and tech-forward, Citrine pilots fly sleek, fast craft and lean on precision over brute force. Line up the shot, commit, and don't miss.

Build your loadout.

Pick a ship. Slot a special weapon. Choose a pilot with their own special maneuver and ability. Every combination plays differently, so the squadron you bring to the table is yours.

FACTION SPOTLIGHT: Amethyst

The fourth faction, and the strangest. Amethyst pilots and their crescent-shaped craft move in ways the others can't predict, which in a game about prediction is a dangerous thing to face.

That's all four. Which one is yours?
